method: Duration- and return-period-specific MGM multiplicative anchoring; change factors preserved for each model and cell.
spatial_assumption: Single-station bias factor transferred uniformly across district; unvalidated in uplands.
temporal_assumption: MGM rolling-duration maxima vs CORDEX fixed 3h/24h blocks; difference not independently corrected.
tail: 200/500y levels are extrapolations from about 30y baseline; supplied LP3 table is a separate 56y reference.
daily_validation_scope: Daily ERA5 validation does not validate CORDEX projections or subdaily rainfall.
